title_zh: 商定先私下了解工作投诉流程

scenario.label_zh: 商定先私下了解工作投诉流程
scenario.goal_zh: 说明虚构员工遭遇，并约定先获取保密投诉流程、暂不对外转述

context_zh: 虚构职场沟通练习：同事谈及工作待遇及不受欢迎的个人评论，不作法律定性。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: They keep asking me to work unpaid after my shift. It feels like exploitation.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Have you spoken to the staff adviser?

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Not yet. My supervisor also keeps making comments about my body, even after I asked him to stop.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: Those comments are inappropriate. The adviser handles concerns about harassment as well as pay.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: I'd like to understand the confidential reporting process before I make a formal complaint.

sentences.speaker: Evan
sentences.text: I can send you the adviser's contact details. I won't repeat what you've told me.

sentences.speaker: Noor
sentences.text: Thank you. Please send the details, and I will contact her myself.
